data_fields.name: armour_wear_per_action
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.01 hp per action at reference latency (1.0 = 1 hp per action)

data_fields.name: carry_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: 1.0 (fractional hp carry reaches one whole point)

best_idea: Each swing costs every worn piece a small fixed amount of durability, scaled by weapon speed so a fast weapon wears less per swing, tracked with a fractional carry so the ledger stays in whole points.
decision_why: Per-swing wear scaled by weapon speed is a clean cost for fast duels, but it must be a server-written step in the duel (one ledger), and Frankendom must choose whether a miss wears gear (the donor wears on misses).
acceptance: Server test: 100 swings with a 20-tick weapon lower the chest piece by 1 hp; 100 swings with a 10-tick weapon leave it unchanged and about 200 swings lower it by 1; a worned piece (hp 1) is skipped and unequipped.
